title: Data table survey coverage
description: Periods during which a subject was surveyed, optionally limited to a scope such as a program or campus. Inside a listed period a missing observation is zero. Outside it the replicate was not surveyed.

scope.description: Survey columns that limit where this period applies. An empty object applies to every replicate. Keys are column names; values are the column values.

subject.description: Exactly one key, the table's subject column, and the subject value that was surveyed.

start.description: First day the subject was surveyed, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD.

end.description: Last day the subject was surveyed, inclusive, as YYYY-MM-DD. Null when the period is still ongoing.
